name: MainStreetUSD
who_can_redeem: KYC-verified users may request direct redemption under MainStreet program rules; current execution, capacity, and settlement performance remain under review.
redemption_region_notes: Identity, jurisdiction, compliance, liquidity, cooldown, and concurrent-redemption limits apply.
redemption_notes: Official documentation describes a seven-day cooldown and limited concurrent redemption capacity. Base msUSD is separate from msY and legacy contract representations.
summary: USDC-referenced stablecoin issued by MainStreet Finance whose reserve-verification relationship ended and whose market price suffered a severe depeg in June 2026.
notes: Emergency Batch N. Classified as impaired, not failed or discontinued; reserve deficit, insolvency, permanent redemption failure, and shutdown are not confirmed.

name: JPYSC
who_can_redeem: Eligible SBI VC Trade account holders may purchase and sell JPYSC at a fixed one-to-one Japanese-yen rate inside the platform, subject to account, compliance, and product terms.
redemption_region_notes: Initial access is limited to eligible SBI VC Trade accounts in Japan. External-wallet transfer and public-chain circulation were not available at launch.
redemption_notes: JPYSC launched in a restricted account-internal phase. The trust-bank issuance structure, platform purchase and sale, future external transfer, and future public-chain circulation are recorded separately.
summary: Japanese-yen stablecoin issued by SBI Shinsei Trust & Banking under a trust structure and initially distributed inside SBI VC Trade with external-wallet transfer unavailable.
notes: Emergency Batch N expansion for the 2026-06-24 launch. Status is limited because the initial product is account-internal and public-chain circulation remains pending.
